question: How do I clean the ductwork in my home to improve airflow and reduce energy bills?
answer: To clean the ductwork in your home, you'll need a few tools and some elbow grease. First, turn off the power to the HVAC system at the circuit breaker or fuse box. Next, use a vacuum cleaner with a hose attachment to remove any debris or dust from the vents. Then, use a specialized duct cleaning brush to scrub the interior of the ducts, working from the return vents to the supply vents. Finally, use a vacuum cleaner to remove any remaining debris and inspect the ducts for any signs of damage or buildup. Remember to wear a dust mask and safety glasses when cleaning the ducts to avoid inhaling any dust or debris. Also, be sure to clean the entire duct system, including any flex ducts or branch lines.
